topic: 在新的晚间英语班交换信息
grammarFocus: 新增：be一般疑问句、not否定、we/they与规则复数；巩固：I am/you are、姓名与班级。
title: 第2课新增 · 写一则欢迎新同学的留言
instructions: 先独立写6—8句、至少40个英文词。可以用真实信息，也可以明确自编班级；写清你与一两位同学合起来是谁（we必须包含你自己），以及两位老师是谁（they不包含你）。加入一个否定句和一个be疑问句。用自己的姓名、班级与教室，不复制阅读或口语示例。提交后按反馈订正，字数和提交本身不表示掌握。
prompt: A new student will join your evening English group. Write a welcome message using your own details or an invented class. Write 6–8 complete sentences and at least 40 words. Include your name, class and room. Use we for yourself together with one or two classmates. Use they for two teachers, not including yourself. Add one negative fact and one yes/no question with be. Do not copy the reading or speaking example.
